title: Picou's clarinets and Laurent's own clarinets with rings
summary: They compare Picou's straight wooden clarinet with the ring-less and ring-equipped clarinets Laurent has owned and kept.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
